scope: Opt-in public-photo sample for actual local person masking and Rust/WASM background flow; retain procedural sample and camera behavior.

photo.license_description: NASA image, documented by scikit-image as public domain; retain attribution.
photo.presentation: Unmodified photo drawn on the existing generated texture; only presentation motion is synthetic. No new sensor capture.

acceptance: Explicit person-sample button; no image download on idle, camera or procedural sample paths.
Actual pinned model yields a nonempty person mask and actual Rust/WASM background tracks in standard and light modes.
AI-off photo playback remains usable and reports AI off without a person mask.
Image errors and wrong dimensions fail clearly; Stop during loading and late image events cannot affect replacement sessions.
Existing lifecycle, mask, geometry, cadence and browser controls pass; all requests stay same-origin GETs without a real camera or microphone.
Pinned image is self-hosted by the existing builder; nine previous vendor pins, raw WASM, production Rust sources and lockfile remain unchanged.
Exact-head CI, merge, matching Pages manifest and public browser photo checks are required before delivery.
limits: A public photograph with synthesized motion is a demo and smoke input, not a calibrated video sequence, person-segmentation accuracy benchmark, GPU speed claim, physical-phone/Safari qualification, metric pose or operational 80% acceptance.
